mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO draw_recon_variance (round_no, check_type, scope_key, biz_id, expect_snapshot, actual_snapshot, state, fixed_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{roundNo}, #{checkType}, #{scopeKey}, #{bizId}, #{expectSnapshot}, #{actualSnapshot}, #{state}, #{fixedTime}, #{finishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, round_no, check_type, scope_key, biz_id, expect_snapshot, actual_snapshot, state, fixed_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time FROM draw_recon_variance WHERE state = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE draw_recon_variance SET state = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0
UPDATE draw_recon_variance SET state = 2, fixed_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 1
UPDATE draw_recon_variance SET state = 4, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0
